create_CosineWithWarmup_scheduler: create a CosineWithWarmup scheduler with an optimizer, total steps, warmup ratio, and minimum learning rate
step_CosineWithWarmup: step the CosineWithWarmup scheduler to advance the learning rate to the next training step
get_last_lr_CosineWithWarmup: get the last learning rate values from the CosineWithWarmup scheduler after stepping
save_CosineWithWarmup_state: save the CosineWithWarmup scheduler state to a dictionary for checkpointing and resuming training
load_CosineWithWarmup_state: load a previously saved CosineWithWarmup scheduler state dictionary to resume training from a checkpoint
